why: a young home's outposts are budgeted on the path their haul walks, not the straight line: on gen 49 the paths run 2-5x the straight range, so a young home took six outposts whose haul the spawn could not cast, their bodies drank the build-out and it sat at RCL2 with its first extensions unbuilt (main: 2 extensions, upgrade 1,070 by t8000) while their dig decayed (33.8k from t2000 to t8000 on 7a552f3e, the build before the fix; 6.1k after)
